top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Set to Fall on Tech, Oil Edges Lower: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks looked set to come under pressure, tracking a selloff in US chipmakers, as speculation about OpenAI’s revenue revived concerns over the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence spending boom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
